ranked.why: with invented, changed, spelling and marks: content faults on 68 of 69 opened pages, the worst fault on 38. Most come from the model's reading (extract on 49 pages, caption on 10, re-read on 7). The layout front causes them on 23 pages: a narrow Zone cuts a line, so the line is read twice ('Ser / Landscape / March'); two Zones overlap, so one region is drawn twice in 4-5 px copies; a line no Zone covers is lost. Unseen pages lose content the 31 kept
19 pages, the worst on 11: a header row lost or shifted (extract), a spanning header read flat, a table cut by layout. Every value after the shift sits under the wrong column
with words: mark lost: 30 pages. Ticks, crosses, numbered discs and step numbers are drawn as bullets, which loses what was ticked and the order. One extract-and-render question asked again and again

with beside, under another heading and fill shape changed: 32 pages where layout groups across what the page separates. Cards lose their pictures, a hero title becomes a column, a band splits into boxes. Few faults per page, each one very visible
10 pages, all render: the text is in the IR but drawn dark on a dark band or white on white, so a title bar, a total or a button shows empty. Content present and unseen: the cheapest visible repair

68 pages, with lines broken differently on 59 and height on 68: display type drawn at body size, small labels drawn at body size, so the page is taller and rewraps. Render, as on the 31; the check over-fires where the difference is not visible, 7 rejected
26 pages: a serif or script page drawn in a sans, the most visible look fault after size. Render and the face measure
with frame missing, frame changed, fill lost and chips drawn as plain text: 35 pages of furniture the render does not draw. Minor one by one, but common
